ns2:course.label: Adv Natural Resource Economics
ns2:course.description: Economic theory is used to examine the allocation of renewable and efficiency issues that arise from natural resource policy and management issues. Same as ECON 515, ENVS 510, and NRES 510. Prerequisite: ECON 302 or equivalent.
